detected_concept: Liquid sloshing in tankers under braking
description:
An experimental animated explainer of what happens inside a liquid tanker when the truck brakes. Cutaway views show a milk tanker and a fuel tanker: both liquids slosh, and the video walks through why baffles, tank design, braking and grip all matter.

This is an animation, not a physics simulation. It shows the idea, not exact fluid dynamics, and both liquids behave broadly similarly here.
